card.name: Dot-com in news URLs
card.fires_on: Mostly the '.com' (or the following slash) in news-site web addresses inside citations, such as nytimes or wsj. Weaker on a few commas or small words in running prose.

modes.label: News URL pieces
modes.description: The '.com', '/' or '_b' inside a web address cited in a reference list.

modes.label: Clause-linking punctuation or words
modes.description: A comma or small word that opens an explanation or a following clause in ordinary prose.
modes.example: Forcing a stroke victim to sit up is never a good idea<<,>> because it can cause a drop in blood

card.plain: It mainly marks the '.com' part of news web addresses in citations, with a few scattered commas in prose.
